title: UAT shareable pack: synthetic pump fire
status: Learning purposes: not a statutory document

bottom_line.text: A pump went back into service after a seal change with no leak test.
No return-to-service checklist set a hold point for the test.

items.lesson: When a joint is disturbed, a leak test before restart is the barrier.
Seals bought without a specification weaken every joint they go into.
A gas alarm that only displays leaves the response to whoever sees it.

items.change: Block restart until a signed leak-test record is attached.
items.indicator: Share of restarts with a leak-test record
